name: Capsule Voice
meaning: A close microphone grille reduced to one capsule and three broad ribs. No stem or stand.
status: original candidate; independent PM review pending; no lead selected
geometry: Closed beveled extrusion of the editable curved paths with continuous bowed depth; original geometry, not a stock mesh
wordmark: Always uppercase OUTSPOKEN. Exact Archivo730 outlines with optical manual tracking; only firstO has a narrow outward voice notch.
small_size_verdict: Mic grille remains distinct at24/32; use mono at small size. Podcast-service association remains a positioning risk.
geometry_checks: finite all attributes; valid all indices; nonzero real depth; permesh bounds recorded
render_quality_limit: Procedural satin/material counterpart; smoother and less photorealistic than root generated brushed-metal art. No raster/GLB pixel parity claim.
